tags: v1.3 缓存/联邦检索/配置
post.description:
Perform federated retrieval across multiple knowledge bases.

Supports optional collection filtering and returns fused results
with performance metadata.

Request body:
    query (str): Search query.
    top_k (int, optional): Maximum results to return (default: 5).
    collections (list[str], optional): Target collection names.
        If omitted or empty, searches all registered knowledge bases.
    weight_strategy (str, optional): Weight strategy: "equal", "weighted", or "rrf".
    weights (dict[str, float], optional): Custom weights per KB (for "weighted" strategy).
    timeout (float, optional): Per-KB timeout in seconds (default: 10.0).

schema.title: Response Federated Retrieve Api V1 Retrieve Federated Post
